facts.anchor: The house stands in shadow, the candles low
I sit at her side in my finest dress, my own throat heavy
We are joined by eleven of society
“To fallen men,” my mother begins the meal
Have my actions hereby drawn some conclusion that I am something soft?
I would long to be held as a child
I have been cut thrice as deep by those of my own blood
I could send out my rats, flea-bitten and black
I swallow wine until it spills from my mouth
Vomit covers my cheek, cold and sticky
There are things in the dark that follow me
And there, by the bedpost, lies a dead rat
I flick it at the beast, and it licks it up
needed in a way that is utterly unfamiliar
